title: Bluetooth issue (serious?)
body:
I'm having serious bluetooth breaks with hundreds of missed readings using a Dexcom G6, aHuawei P10 and the October-nightly of xdrip+.

After running  for more than 10 mont my last 81-series transmitter had battery failure.  I had to switch to a firefly transmitter last week. Since then, after fast and "normal" connection the Bluetooth-connection breaks down after  a  minututes to hours and will not recover without deleting the Dexcom Transmiiter from the BT-device-list and restarting the phone.
After that re-connection is established but the same problems occurs again after some time. 
There is an OB1-error concerning bluetooth which I don't understand (see below)..

Anyone with an idea how to solve this?
Is this an issue with only "my" mobile phone (running on EMUI 9.10) or a general Problem?

With this situation now, I just start to Feel how "easy" everything went with always availablr readings for weeks...

Thanky for your support

Oliver 

![Screenshot_20201030_143213_com eveningoutpost dexdrip](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/47924153/97713381-0a131d80-1ac0-11eb-89c0-feb040e7faf0.jpg)

comments.body: Just a guess: The log says something about authentication (auth challenge, AuthRequest...), have you tried to change the  "Allow OB1 unbonding" and "Allow OB1 initiate bonding" options?

Actually no, as I thought these are an absolute requirement when using Dexcom 6...   
Does anybody know if leaving these unckeck is an option..???

What is strange, that the last 2 years I had no such issues with the old transmitters but now with the first firefly  model things are getting weird..

I also use the newer Butterfly transmitter (8Jxxxx) with Samsung A40. My setting is "Allow OB1 unbonding"=true and "Allow OB1 initiate bonding"=true. My suggestion was just because the description of the option was "...If you get problems with it unpairing then disable this option...".

I have no problem with the connection so far and I have the same errors for Ob1G5StateMachine in the logs. 

Can you show the difference in the logs between working and not working and the part where it breaks?

Thank you for your thoughts - unfortunately the problems seems to get more severe...
I kooked through the log and couldn't find a "real initial" error or entry which breaks down the connection.
The only thing I found was the GATT related message from the OB1 machine.
Another sceenshot is attached which (I believe) represents the time point of failure...

It did so very well (sensor used for 20-30 days, transmitter use for 10 month) for more than a year now and the only thing changed is the switch to firelfly transmitters...
![Screenshot_20201107_112945_com eveningoutpost dexdrip](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/47924153/98438880-8c699600-20ed-11eb-815b-91bac7eee7a6.jpg)

Hi
I think I have the same issue. I installed the Samsung November update and then the cell phone keeps asking Bluetooth pairing requests every 5 or 10 minutes. I needed to accept those requests every time otherwise I don't get any BG. After the 15.11.2020 xDrip+ update now I have continuously no BG displayed and Aggressively restarting collector service due to lack differently sometimes 360 240 180 120.
Transmitter: 8H20AH days 80
Senser day 12
Samsung Note 10+
The same transmitter and sensor working fine with an old Samsung cell phone but I need to use this phone for AAPS and Closed Loop.
Thanks.
@whynot2018 Did you follow the discussion at https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1494#issuecomment-728824828 onwards?

Ok now it works.
I had to setup.
Settings-->G5/G6 Debug Settings
Use the OB1 Collector
Native Algorithm
Minimize Scanning
Avoid Scanning
G6 Support
Allow OB1 initiate bonding

Less common settings-->Bluetooth Settings
Turn Bluetooth on
Bluetooth Watchdog
Trust Auto-Connect

It’s good read that it‘s not only myself and that probably neither myself nor my phone is crazy…

 

What’s strange is that in my case the new transmitter (Firmware 2.18.2.98 – what’s yours?) did make the difference between smoothly and faulty running…

 

No real improvement with the latest November-version of xdrip+ in my case…

 

Regards

 

Oliver
